newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Asia Amalgamated 1996 net at 8.36 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Asia Amalgamated 1996 net at 8.36 mln pesos.

text.p: The Philippines' Asia Amalgamated Holdings Corp said on Thursday it posted a net income of 8.36 million pesos in 1996 from a 6.76 million net loss the previous year.
In a statement, Asia Amalgamated president Jaime Cabangis attributed profits last year largely to the performance of a wholly-owned subsidiary, Ecology Savings Bank Inc.
Ecology Bank made a net income of 8.33 million in 1996, Cabangis said.
Asia Amalgamated is the holding company of the Gow family, franchise holders of Uniwide Sales, a chain of warehouse-type supermarkets and department stores in Manila.
Asia Amalgamated is also involved in the commercial ferry tranport business.
Cabangis said another unit, Unikleen International Corp is planning to put up its own water bottling plant while supplying the requirements of the entire Uniwide group.
